body:
GFL Environmental rejected a take-private offer of US$52 a share, valuing the company at about US$22 billion, from a consortium led by Blackstone, KKR and Energy Capital Partners, The Globe and Mail reported on Monday, citing two people familiar with the matter [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). The offer was a 13% premium to GFL's Monday close of US$45.88 on the New York Stock Exchange [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/).

The board asked the consortium for US$58 a share or more, and the bidders declined, according to the report [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). Directors ended the four-month strategic review late Monday, and GFL was expected to announce on Tuesday that it concluded without a sale [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). GFL had not commented publicly at the time of writing.

GFL opened the review in July after receiving what founder and chief executive Patrick Dovigi called "unsolicited preliminary expressions of interest from multiple parties to take the company private" [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). A special committee of independent directors, advised by CIBC, set a Nov. 9 deadline for final offers, GFL disclosed with its third-quarter results on Oct. 28 [[2]](https://www.wastedive.com/news/gfl-sets-nov-9-deadline-for-take-private-offers-touts-strong-q3/873194/). In that quarter revenue rose 27.2% to C$2.16 billion, helped by the Secure Waste Infrastructure acquisition, and GFL raised its full-year revenue forecast to more than C$8 billion [[2]](https://www.wastedive.com/news/gfl-sets-nov-9-deadline-for-take-private-offers-touts-strong-q3/873194/).

Dovigi had said he would roll over his stake, keeping about 33% under new owners, but was unwilling to back a deal the board considered unfair to public shareholders, the Globe's sources said [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). The US$52 bid implied about 12 times GFL's forecast 2027 earnings, below the 14 to 16 times at which the sector's leaders trade, the newspaper calculated [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/).

As part of ending the review, GFL will let BC Partners, which owns about 13%, sell a large portion of its stake to outside investors, according to the report [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). GFL's shares have risen more than 20% since the review was announced, and 15 of the 17 analysts covering the stock forecast a price above US$50 within a year [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). GFL is North America's fourth-largest waste company, behind Waste Management, Republic Services and Waste Connections[[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/).

p: The Globe and Mail은 월요일 두 명의 소식통을 인용해, GFL Environmental이 Blackstone, KKR, Energy Capital Partners가 이끄는 컨소시엄의 주당 52달러 상장폐지(take-private) 인수 제안을 거절했다고 보도했다. 이 제안은 회사 가치를 약 220억 달러로 평가한 것이다 [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). 제안가는 월요일 뉴욕증권거래소(NYSE) GFL 종가 45.88달러에 13%의 프리미엄을 얹은 수준이었다 [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/).

보도에 따르면 이사회는 컨소시엄에 주당 58달러 이상을 요구했으나 입찰 측이 이를 받아들이지 않았다 [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). 이사진은 월요일 늦게 4개월간의 전략적 검토를 마무리했으며, GFL은 화요일 매각 없이 검토를 종료했다고 발표할 것으로 예상됐다 [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). GFL은 이 기사 작성 시점까지 공식 입장을 내놓지 않았다.

GFL은 창업자 겸 최고경영자(CEO) Patrick Dovigi가 "여러 곳으로부터 회사를 상장폐지하겠다는 요청하지 않은 예비 인수 의향"이라고 표현한 제안을 받은 뒤 지난 7월 검토에 착수했다 [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). CIBC의 자문을 받는 독립 이사 특별위원회는 최종 제안 마감일을 11월 9일로 정했으며, GFL은 10월 28일 3분기 실적 발표와 함께 이를 공시했다 [[2]](https://www.wastedive.com/news/gfl-sets-nov-9-deadline-for-take-private-offers-touts-strong-q3/873194/). 해당 분기 매출은 Secure Waste Infrastructure 인수 효과에 힘입어 27.2% 증가한 21억 6천만 캐나다 달러를 기록했고, GFL은 연간 매출 전망치를 80억 캐나다 달러 이상으로 상향했다 [[2]](https://www.wastedive.com/news/gfl-sets-nov-9-deadline-for-take-private-offers-touts-strong-q3/873194/).

Globe의 소식통들은 Dovigi가 자신의 지분을 재투자(roll over)해 새 소유주 아래에서도 약 33%를 유지하겠다는 뜻을 밝혔지만, 이사회가 일반 주주에게 불공정하다고 판단한 거래는 지지할 의사가 없었다고 전했다 [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). 이 신문의 계산에 따르면 주당 52달러 제안은 GFL의 2027년 예상 이익의 약 12배에 해당해, 업계 선두 업체들이 거래되는 14~16배를 밑돌았다 [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/).

보도에 따르면 GFL은 검토 종료의 일환으로 지분 약 13%를 보유한 BC Partners가 보유 지분의 상당 부분을 외부 투자자에게 매각하도록 허용할 예정이다 [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). GFL 주가는 검토 착수가 발표된 이후 20% 넘게 올랐고, 이 종목을 분석하는 애널리스트 17명 중 15명이 1년 내 50달러 이상으로 오를 것으로 전망했다 [[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/). GFL은 Waste Management, Republic Services, Waste Connections에 이은 북미 4위 폐기물 처리 업체다[[1]](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-gfl-environmental-turns-down-buyout-offer-wall-street-private-equity/).
